leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi John,

My name is Roland Jacobs, and I work as a designer and book services specialist, helping authors present and promote their books with care.

I came across Heartland Highways: In Search of America while researching your work. I enjoyed the idea of being a 'detourist' rather than a tourist, following locals' advice that something is just fifteen minutes that way, across 33,321 miles. As a broadcaster you already know the value of a good story told well, so I had an idea for how YouTube automation could turn the road trip into a steady series of short episodes, each pointing back to the book and audiobook.

If it's useful, I could prepare a complimentary concept sample to show the idea more clearly. Would you be open to seeing it?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
